program_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
source='''from collections import Counter


def transform(grid):
    height, width = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    background = Counter(value for row in grid for value in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    colors = {value for row in grid for value in row if value not in (0, background)}
    marker = next(iter(colors))
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == marker]
    min_r = min(r for r, c in cells)
    min_c = min(c for r, c in cells)
    pattern = [(r - min_r, c - min_c) for r, c in cells]
    pattern_h = max(r for r, c in pattern) + 1
    pattern_w = max(c for r, c in pattern) + 1

    result = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for top in range(height - pattern_h + 1):
        for left in range(width - pattern_w + 1):
            positions = [(top + r, left + c) for r, c in pattern]
            if all(grid[r][c] == 0 for r, c in positions):
                for r, c in positions:
                    result[r][c] = marker
    return result
'''
